overview: Close cross-cutting infrastructure gaps: i18n framework, Sentry crash reporting, code syntax highlighting, inline images in markup, global error toast, clipboard support, offline mutation queue, universal links, and haptic feedback.

scopeCuts: Focus on cross-cutting infrastructure inside mobile/src/ affecting multiple modules
Exclude mermaid rendering (P3), analytics/telemetry (needs privacy review), module-specific features

prerequisites: Existing mobile app scaffold with NativeWind, expo-router, TanStack Query, Zustand
MarkupRenderer handles basic rich text already
ErrorBoundary wraps the app at root layout level
WebSocket sidecar operational for real-time invalidation
nonGoals: Full offline-first architecture (only mutation queue, not offline reads)
Server-side changes for universal link verification
contracts: i18n framework must be non-invasive: wrap existing strings progressively
Sentry must not transmit PII in crash reports
Offline mutation queue must replay in order and handle conflict resolution
Universal links must coexist with the existing huly:// custom scheme
Haptic feedback must respect system Reduce Motion settings

tasks.title: Add i18n framework with progressive string extraction
tasks.description: Set up react-i18next with baseline English and wrap the most visible screens as proof of progressive adoption.
acceptanceCriteria: react-i18next configured with English default and lazy-loaded locale files from assets/locales/.
At least 3 screens (login, settings index, tab labels) use useTranslation() instead of hardcoded strings.
Missing translation keys fall back to English and log a dev warning, not a crash or empty string.

tasks.title: Add Sentry crash reporting
tasks.description: Integrate @sentry/react-native for crash reporting and unhandled exception tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Sentry initializes at app startup with DSN from environment config; disabled in dev mode.
ErrorBoundary componentDidCatch sends errors to Sentry with breadcrumbs (screen name, last action).
No PII (auth tokens, emails, workspace URLs) appears in Sentry payloads; scrubbing rules configured.

tasks.title: Add code syntax highlighting in MarkupRenderer
tasks.description: Upgrade code blocks to render with syntax highlighting using a lightweight RN-compatible highlighter.
acceptanceCriteria: Code blocks with language annotation render with syntax-highlighted tokens.
Code blocks without language annotation render as plain monospace text.
Highlighting does not block main thread for large blocks (>100 lines); uses memo.

tasks.title: Add inline image rendering in MarkupRenderer
tasks.description: Upgrade image references in markup from text links to actual inline images.
acceptanceCriteria: Markup tags render as inline expo-image components with automatic caching.
Images respect max width (screen width - padding) and maintain aspect ratio; tap opens full-screen viewer.
Broken image URLs show a placeholder icon instead of crashing or showing blank space.

tasks.title: Add global error toast
tasks.description: Replace per-screen error handling with a global toast/snackbar system.
acceptanceCriteria: Global toast component mounts at root layout and shows errors dispatched via Zustand store.
Toast auto-dismisses after 4s; multiple toasts queue rather than overlap.
Network errors from TanStack Query onError global handler route to the toast.

tasks.title: Add clipboard copy for messages and code blocks
tasks.description: Allow users to copy message text and code block content to clipboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press on a code block shows a Copy action via expo-clipboard.
Long-press on a message bubble includes a Copy Text option for plain-text representation.
Successful copy shows a brief Copied toast; clipboard errors show an error toast.

tasks.title: Add offline mutation queue
tasks.description: Queue mutations when offline and replay when connectivity returns.
acceptanceCriteria: When offline, mutations are queued in a Zustand store persisted to AsyncStorage.
When connectivity returns, queued mutations replay in order; conflicts show user-actionable resolution.
Queue state visible via banner (X pending changes) and clears on successful replay.

tasks.title: Add universal links (iOS/Android)
tasks.description: Configure associated domains so huly.io links open directly in the mobile app.
acceptanceCriteria: app.json configures associatedDomains (iOS) and intentFilters (Android) for huly.io.
Deep links from universal links route through resolveNotificationRoute() path.
Links to unknown routes open the app to the default tab instead of crashing.

tasks.title: Add haptic feedback
tasks.description: Add tactile feedback for key interactions using expo-haptics.
acceptanceCriteria: expo-haptics is called on swipe-to-archive, bulk action confirmation, and pull-to-refresh.
Haptics respect system Reduce Motion setting; no vibration when enabled.
Devices without haptic hardware silently skip without errors.

failureModes.recovery: App continues without crash reporting; no user-visible error

failureModes.failure: i18n locale file fails to load
failureModes.recovery: Fall back to English; log warning in dev

failureModes.detection: Large code block causes frame drops
failureModes.recovery: Limit highlighting to first 200 lines; show truncated indicator
Show resolution UI; allow discard or retry with fresh data
Fall back to default tab; log the unparseable URL
Show error toast instead of silent failure

testCoverageMap: TASK-001: i18n init + useTranslation on 3 screens + missing key fallback
TASK-002: Sentry init + ErrorBoundary integration + PII scrubbing
TASK-003: highlighted code block + plain fallback + large block performance
TASK-004: inline image rendering + broken URL placeholder + aspect ratio
TASK-005: toast dispatch + auto-dismiss + queue + global onError wiring
TASK-006: clipboard copy code + copy message + error toast on failure
TASK-007: offline queue + ordered replay + conflict resolution UI + banner state
TASK-008: associated domains config + universal link routing + unknown route fallback
TASK-009: haptic on actions + Reduce Motion respect + no-hardware graceful skip
